title: Preoperative Portal and Splanchnic Flow Measurement Using MRI
brief_summary: This study aims to assess the alteration of portal and splanchnic flow using MRI after liver transplantation in patients with splenomegaly or splenic varix.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* older than 18 years
* And signed informed consent
* And planned either a) liver transplantation as a recipient; or b) liver transplantation as a donor

Exclusion Criteria:

* any absolute/relative contraindication of contrast-enhanced MRI
